summary: I built the frontend of an internal operations platform for a BRAC program, working part-time alongside one backend engineer. Staff use it to sign up and get approved, manage projects, branches and learner cohorts, and send official requests through approval chains that end in a signed Bangla PDF..

projects.title: Program Operations Platform
projects.what: Program staff used to handle sign-ups, project records and approval paperwork by hand. The platform puts users, projects, cohorts, budgets and approvals in one place and generates the final documents as PDFs.
built: Built login with email and Google, sign-up requests, OTP password reset and a profile completion step for new users.
Built user management: an all-users table with search and filters, a pending-users approval queue, a small dashboard, user detail pages and admin password resets.
Built role-based access with a role guard used across pages and actions, and later reworked role management with new roles and designations.
Built the approval system: create, edit and track requests, see pending and 'my approvals' tabs, search them, and view approval history and comments with file uploads.
Built ten approval form types, including invoice, discount for learners with disabilities, reimbursement and transfer bills, unpaid leave, insufficient learner enrollment and orientation requests.
Built Bangla PDF generation for approvals with BRAC branding, Bangla numerals and dates, PDF preview with fallback, and e-signature upload placed on the document.
Built project management for areas, branches and projects, with cohort lists, cohort details and cohort updates per project.
Built project budgets and expenditure tracking by year and cohort, plus research document uploads.
Built Excel exports for users, projects and cohorts with formatting and a watermark.
Built location dropdowns for division, district and upazila, a rich text editor, and responsive layouts for phones and tablets.
